meta.title: A ₹0 unit price is not a quote and never becomes L1
gaps: The plan covers the refused-bid outcome only; it does not verify the alternate outcome where the zero-price line is accepted but left unquoted and vendor 2 remains L1.
No application error code for a zero unit price is provided.

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer invites QA vendor 2 to the live round.
A second QA vendor places a complete bid of 50 (open, price, submit).
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid of 0 (open, price, submit).
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing).

plan.title: A ₹0 unit price is not a quote and never becomes L1

assert.say: the round counts no new bid (the refused bid left nothing)
